evals.prompt: Wire our internal metrics server into this plugin. It is an HTTP server behind a bearer token that must not be committed.
evals.expected_output: An .mcp.json http entry with the token supplied by interpolation rather than literal text.
expectations: An .mcp.json http entry with the token supplied by interpolation rather than literal text.

evals.prompt: I added allowed-tools for mcp__metrics__query in my plugin skill and it still prompts for permission every time.
evals.expected_output: A correction to the plugin-scoped tool name, with the derivation shown.
expectations: A correction to the plugin-scoped tool name, with the derivation shown.

evals.prompt: Our MCP server exposes 40 tools and Claude picks the wrong one constantly. Help.
evals.expected_output: Consolidation and description guidance treating tool descriptions as a routing surface.
expectations: Consolidation and description guidance treating tool descriptions as a routing surface.

evals.prompt: Should this server be stdio or http? It runs locally today but the team also uses Claude on their phones.
evals.expected_output: A recommendation of http with the reason that stdio is absent on web and mobile.
expectations: A recommendation of http with the reason that stdio is absent on web and mobile.

evals.prompt: The server connects fine according to /mcp but Claude never uses any of its tools.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis pointing at tool descriptions or naming rather than transport.
expectations: A diagnosis pointing at tool descriptions or naming rather than transport.
